_comment_note: Each entry maps a PDI DB connection to an Airflow conn_id. The mapper tries entries in this order within each confidence tier. More-specific entries should come first.
pdi_names: exact PDI connection name(s) for highest-confidence match. host_keywords / database_keywords: substrings matched against the PDI connection's host and database fields.
